mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log (admin_id, action, target, detail, ip) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{action}, #{target}, #{detail}, #{ip})
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, au.nickname as admin_name FROM admin_log l LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON l.admin_id = au.admin_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
